metadata_identity.record_title: Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics

repository.license_interpretation: The candidate artifact license is taken from the Zenodo release record; GitHub's repository-level license field does not supply an SPDX assertion.

curator_record_overlap.risk: Shared curator and release record create packaging- and selection-level dependence; distinct artifacts do not by themselves establish independent scientific lineage.
curator_record_overlap.replacement_implication: HDFS-v1 may remain a replacement candidate, but it cannot be counted as an additional independent LogPAI family alongside Loghub Linux without a separately authorized lineage audit.

lineage_assessment.pseudoreplication_warning: Many block traces from one benchmark collection must not be treated as many independent experiments, runs, hosts, or source families.
lineage_assessment.future_requirement: A separately authorized bounded lineage audit must establish collection/run boundaries before any lineage or quota claim.

required_future_controls: Physically isolate label artifacts before any payload inspection or normalization.
Treat block ID only as a visible entity or grouping key until lineage is separately verified.
Do not use labels, label-derived paths, split assignments, or anomaly proportions in prompts, inputs, normalization targets, or training targets.
Any use of excluded labels as private scorer gold requires separate explicit authorization and must never feed the model or admission path.

hadoop_sibling_guard.reason: The current authorization explicitly excludes Hadoop as a second independent family, and shared LogPAI curation/record metadata cannot establish scientific independence.

positive: The release DOI, concept DOI, publication date, CC-BY-4.0 license statement, artifact name, byte size, MD5, repository, and pinned repository commit are independently machine-checkable from official metadata.
The metadata is sufficient to retain HDFS-v1 as a named candidate for a future replacement decision.
limitations: HDFS-v1 and Loghub Linux share the same LogPAI curator and Zenodo release record.
Block IDs identify traces inside one benchmark collection but do not establish independent runs or replicates.
Normal/abnormal labels are excluded from all model-visible and supervision paths.
No payload-level sample capacity, pointer quality, modality coverage, or scientific lineage has been demonstrated.
verdict_rationale.meaning: approve_as_metadata_candidate is not replacement approval, download authorization, role assignment, quota credit, or L2 Gate passage.
